In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。
segments.text:
In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

segments.body:
She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。
segments.text:
She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

segments.body:
It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
凶手似乎费尽心机来隐藏她的身份。
segments.text:
It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
凶手似乎费尽心机来隐藏她的身份。

segments.body:
For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。
segments.text:
For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

segments.body:
Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。
segments.text:
Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

segments.body:
But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。
